body.x: Marking its third edition this year, FIX 2026 (Future Innovation Tech Expo), South Korea’s benchmark future industry exhibition, will be held from Wednesday, October 21 to Saturday, October 24 at EXCO in Daegu. Under the slogan “AI, Beyond Tech into Reality,” the expo establishes a new milestone for global industry by organically linking core technologies across four key advanced sectors: future mobility, robotics, AI and ICT, and startups. Encompassing the achievements of Daegu Metropolitan City’s forward-looking industrial cultivation, leading domestic and international tech enterprises alongside promising startups will assemble to unveil next-generation, field-validated technologies poised to transform everyday life and industrial operations. Concurrently featuring international conferences, global business matchmaking sessions, and open innovation initiatives, the event is set to serve as a pivotal exchange hub leading technological collaboration and innovation far beyond Asia.

Participating as an official Global Media Award partner for FIX 2026, Pokde.Net is an influential technology and digital lifestyle media agency headquartered in Malaysia, commanding substantial reach across Southeast Asia and global markets. Delivering unbiased, objective, in-depth reviews and timely industry news spanning the IT hardware, consumer electronics, gadgets, gaming, and automotive sectors, the platform attracts over 20 million visitors annually to its website. In particular, it has built solid global credibility through rigorous journalistic reporting that looks beyond marketing rhetoric to examine tangible product execution, unit economics, and real-world compatibility. Representing Southeast Asia’s dynamic digital consumers and high-tech user base, Pokde.Net plans to vividly showcase South Korea’s refined hardware and advanced devices to international audiences throughout the expo. An advance interview was conducted with Mubashar Aftab, Founder and CEO of Pokde.Net, to discuss grounded tech trends and his expectations for FIX 2026.

body.x: 1. Could you introduce your media outlet to Korean readers?

Pokde.Net is a digital media agency headquartered in Malaysia specializing in consumer technology, gadgets, gaming hardware, automotive tech, and digital lifestyle products. In addition to delivering daily industry reporting, the team produces objective, independent reviews for a global readership. The website attracts over 20 million visitors annually, serving a diverse international audience across a range of demographics and professional backgrounds.
2. What are your perspectives on current trends across industrial technology, mobility, and AI?
Discourse across these three domains often far outpaces verified field deployment data, and the primary constraints remain rooted in the physical world.

In industrial technology, humanoid robotics is currently an overhyped segment. While technical demonstrations are visually impressive, profitable enterprise deployments remain largely confined to pilot phases with unproven unit economics. Tangible commercial returns are emerging instead from less flashy operational domains, such as machine vision inspection, predictive maintenance, autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), and power grid equipment. The primary bottleneck on the factory floor is not model sophistication, but messy legacy data integration and siloed operational systems. Discussing an AI transformation in manufacturing without solving these integration hurdles is essentially selling presentation slides.

In mobility, the electric vehicle market exhibits distinct regional dynamics. Aggressive pricing and intense competition from China are heavily reshaping export landscapes, while portions of North America and Europe face headwinds from shifting tariffs and revised subsidy policies. Robotaxis operate within defined geofenced zones, yet scaling beyond those boundaries is progressing much more slowly than initially projected. For the majority of consumers, battery chemistry—evidenced by the ascendancy of LFP and the early adoption of sodium-ion chemistries—carries more practical weight than autonomous driving software. Across the broader mobility sector, the decisive variables are regulation and battery safety rather than nominal performance figures. A single thermal runaway controversy can reset an entire category, making strict compliance capabilities the defining differentiator between serious manufacturers and mere importers.

In artificial intelligence, capital expenditure continues to outpace verified revenue generation, and power grid constraints are becoming a concrete physical bottleneck limiting data center expansion. AI agents demonstrate compelling operational efficacy in coding environments, but struggle to replicate that reliability across other complex operational workflows. As performance gaps between frontier models narrow, competitive moats are shifting toward distribution channels, proprietary enterprise datasets, and workflow lock-in. The most vulnerable assumption underpinning AI optimism is that enterprise demand will expand rapidly enough to justify current infrastructure outlays. Furthermore, while AI serves as a powerful engine for global industrial development, raw material monopolization has created an ironic dynamic in which general consumer and industrial manufacturing—the very sectors that produce components vital to running AI—face operational risks.
3. What key issues and topics related to FIX 2026 will interest your readership most?

The readership maintains keen interest in autonomous mobility, robotics, artificial intelligence, next-generation wearables, consumer gadgets, and smart home technologies, as well as virtually any sector where advanced tech interfaces directly with user experiences.
4. As this is your first time attending FIX, what are your primary expectations?

Artificial intelligence has reached a notable stage of technical maturity. A key expectation for this event is encountering a broader range of practical, deployment-ready solutions. Observing advancements across autonomous mobility, intelligent robotics, and humanoid systems will be a major focus. Additionally, identifying cutting-edge consumer gadgets and wearable devices that deliver genuine utility rather than iterative minor refreshes remains a primary area of anticipation.
5. What are your thoughts on participating as an official Global Media Award partner?

Serving as an official Global Media Award partner is a tremendous honor. Participating in an international exhibition of this scale serves as a humbling reminder of what Pokde.Net does best. A platform like FIX aligns closely with Pokde.Net's core editorial identity, and contributing as an official media partner is a source of considerable pride.

body.x: Meanwhile, ten prominent global media partners spanning Europe, the Americas, and Asia are participating as official press partners for FIX 2026, deploying on-site reporting delegations.

The international press corps includes leading technology and industry media representing their respective regions: Le Café du Geek, a French IT, lifestyle, and global tech publication; Clipset, a pioneering Spanish mobile and consumer tech outlet; Ubergizmo, a Silicon Valley-based American consumer electronics and innovative tech portal; AVING USA, an American global tech, business, and exhibition media outlet; Otaku Soken, a Japanese subculture and AI, VR, and IT convergence publication; DIGITIMES, world-renowned semiconductor and ICT supply chain media and research agency; VietnamPlus, a state-run multinational comprehensive news portal in Vietnam; ChinaByte, China’s first enterprise digital transformation (DX), IT, and AI publication; ET Manufacturing, an Indian smart factory, robotics, and manufacturing engineering media outlet; and Pokde.net, a Malaysian hardware, gaming, and mobile tech publication.

These global media partners will participate directly in on-site evaluations during the event, including the FIX Innovation Awards press conference and the Global Media Selected Best of FIX 2026 Media Awards, reporting from the front lines of technological developments by innovative enterprises shaping the future of South Korea’s high-tech landscape.
